characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Young male, early 20s, slim build, fair complexion, dark curly hair. Clean-shaven.
characters.wardrobe: Dark grey polo shirt, blue jeans, black over-ear headphones, black cross-body bag strap.
characters.demeanor: Relaxed, casual, engaged with his phone.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Metallic humanoid female robot. Silver plating, smooth sculpted face, glowing blue eyes, articulated joints.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: I am giving an English interview tomorrow.
Miss Nova says: Almost, Rahul! Say, I am appearing for an English interview tomorrow. Give means to hand something over.
Rahul says: Ah, got it. You know, my English is actually getting so much better.
Miss Nova says: Very good! Where are you learning to speak so well?
Rahul says: From you, on the Supernova AI app! You are Miss Nova, my personal AI teacher.
Rahul says: I love that you do not just give me random lessons. You figured out my exact level and built a personalized plan just for me.
Miss Nova says: And I never judge your mistakes.
Rahul says: Exactly! I can make a thousand mistakes sitting right here on this crowded train, and you correct me without laughing.
Miss Nova says: Because you learn by actually speaking out loud, not just reading.
Rahul says: Yes. People waste hours scrolling feeds on their phones, but I just spend fifteen minutes a day speaking with you.
Miss Nova says: That is right. With daily practice, most learners start seeing visible progress in about a month.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Live correction of a common Indian-English error (giving an interview) to name English early.
- Payload: Hits personalization (a) and privacy/no-judgement (b) heavily in the middle.
- Close: Contrasts scrolling feeds with 15 mins/day of speaking practice.
